SELECT T1.suserid, T1.sgamecode, SUM(T1.ionlinetime) as ionlinetime
FROM dws_mgamejp_login_user_activity_di AS T1
JOIN dim_vplayerid_vies_df AS T2 ON T1.suserid = T2.suserid
WHERE T2.slabel = '其他'
  AND T2.dt = '2025-07-24'
  AND T1.sbusinesstype = '竞品'
  AND T1.sgamecode IN ('initiatived','jordass','esports','allianceforce','strategy','playzone','su')
  AND T1.saccounttype = '-100'
  AND T1.suseridtype IN ('qq','wxid')
  AND T1.splattype = '-100'
  AND T1.splat = '-100'
  AND T1.dt BETWEEN '2025-05-30' AND '2025-07-24'
GROUP BY T1.suserid, T1.sgamecode

SELECT T1.vplayerid 
FROM dws_argothek_ce1_cbt2_vplayerid_suserid_di AS T1 
WHERE T1.dtstatdate BETWEEN '2025-07-17' AND '2025-07-23' 
  AND T1.vplayerid NOT IN (SELECT vplayerid FROM dim_extract_311381_conf)
  AND T1.is_paid = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.gplayerid
FROM dws_argothek_oss_login_di AS T1
JOIN dim_argothek_gplayerid2qqwxid_df AS T2 ON T1.iuserid = T2.iuserid
JOIN dws_mgamejp_login_user_activity_di AS T3 ON T2.suserid = T3.suserid
WHERE T1.statis_date BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250131
  AND T3.dtstatdate BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250131
  AND T3.sgamecode = 'initiatived'
  AND T3.saccounttype = '-100'
  AND T3.suseridtype IN ('qq', 'wxid')
  AND T3.splattype IN ('-100', 'PC')
  AND T3.splat = '-100'
